title: Vanilla Date Bliss Bars
description: A sweet and gooey dessert bar made with dates, vanilla, and bliss.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Line an 8x8 inch baking dish with parchment paper.
In a food processor, blend dates, vanilla, and bliss until well combined.
In a separate bowl, mix together almond flour, coconut oil, maple syrup, and salt.
Press half the almond flour mixture into the prepared baking dish.
Spread the date mixture evenly over the crust.
Top with the remaining almond flour mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden.
Let cool completely before cutting into bars.
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
